summary: Security levels on work items are stored but never enforced. A restricted item must behave as if it never existed for everyone outside its level, wherever it is named, listed, counted or pointed at.
ticket_rules: A person outside an item's level gets the same answer for it as for an id that was never used, and the request changes nothing.
Lists, counts, links, history and exports show only what the viewer could open directly.
Members of the level and administrators see everything as today.

criteria.text: by-id reads and writes answer like a never-used id
counts and summaries (sprint, epic, release, board plan) exclude restricted items
pickers, search and suggestions exclude them
links to and from a restricted item vanish in both directions

authz-by-id.build: check the level in the item loader
authz-by-id.hidden_case_it_fails: a release count computed by a separate aggregate query

central_change_risk: One per-request user context consulted by every lookup gets close; aggregates that never load an item escape it.

measured.slips: release count leaked in both failed builds
